dialogues.jp: 「杉並」
dialogues.en: "Suginami."
dialogues.text: "Suginami."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お、朝倉。遅かったな」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura. You're late."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura. You're late."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっとな。それより、一緒に帰らないか？」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. Shall we head out together?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah. Shall we head out together?"

dialogues.jp: なにやら熱心に書いている杉並の肩に手を置く。
dialogues.en:
I put my hand on his shoulder. He was writing something
seriously.
dialogues.text:
I put my hand on his shoulder. He was writing something
seriously.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「俺のほうは問題ないぞ。ちょうど大佐への報
　告も書き終えたところだからな」
dialogues.en: "I'm good to go. I just finished my report to the colonel."
dialogues.text: "I'm good to go. I just finished my report to the colonel."

dialogues.jp:
そういって、今まで書いていたプリントを封筒
に仕舞い込み、封をする。
dialogues.en: Then he stuffed his report into the envelope and sealed it.
dialogues.text: Then he stuffed his report into the envelope and sealed it.

dialogues.jp:
表には“ＴＯＰ　ＳＥＣＲＥＴ”の赤い文字
が……。
dialogues.en: It was marked as 'TOP SECRET' in red....
dialogues.text: It was marked as 'TOP SECRET' in red....

dialogues.jp: 「まあ、とにかく行くか」
dialogues.en: "Shall we go?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we go?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おう」
dialogues.en: "Yep."
dialogues.text: "Yep."

dialogues.jp: 封筒を鞄に仕舞い込み、杉並が立ち上がる。
dialogues.en: He packed the envelope into his bag and stood up.
dialogues.text: He packed the envelope into his bag and stood up.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「どうだ朝倉。これから牛丼屋に行って、この
　前の話の続きをしないか？」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, Asakura. Do you want to go to the beef bowl joint and
continue our conversation from the other day?"
dialogues.text:
"Hey, Asakura. Do you want to go to the beef bowl joint and
continue our conversation from the other day?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「この前の話って……『ネギだく』と『汁だく』
　についてか？」
dialogues.en:
"Our conversation from the other day...... meaning 'extra
onions' and 'extra soup'?"
dialogues.text:
"Our conversation from the other day...... meaning 'extra
onions' and 'extra soup'?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「うむ」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いや、今日はパスだ」
dialogues.en: "No, I'll pass today."
dialogues.text: "No, I'll pass today."

dialogues.jp:
さっき鍋をご馳走になったばっかりで、お腹一
杯だ。
dialogues.en: I was still full up from the hot pot.
dialogues.text: I was still full up from the hot pot.

dialogues.jp:
「それに、行っても追い出されるんじゃない
　か？」
dialogues.en: "Wouldn't they kick us out anyway?"
dialogues.text: "Wouldn't they kick us out anyway?"

dialogues.jp:
この前は６時間も延々と語っていたから、ブラッ
クリストに載っているだろう。
dialogues.en:
We must be on their blacklist as we stayed more than six
hours just talking last time.
dialogues.text:
We must be on their blacklist as we stayed more than six
hours just talking last time.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「それもそうだな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, you've got a point."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, you've got a point."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「仕方がない。今日は活動を控えるしかなさそ
　うだ」
dialogues.en: "Oh well. We'd better take it easy today then."
dialogues.text: "Oh well. We'd better take it easy today then."

dialogues.jp:
どうせなら、未来永劫、生命活動を休止してい
て欲しいものだ。
dialogues.en: It would be nice if he could take it easy forever.
dialogues.text: It would be nice if he could take it easy forever.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「では、目立たぬていどで、何か計画を考える
　としよう」
dialogues.en: "Ok, I'll think of something more easy then."
dialogues.text: "Ok, I'll think of something more easy then."

dialogues.jp: なぜ、俺はこいつを誘ってしまったんだろうか？
dialogues.en: Why did I ask him to head out together?
dialogues.text: Why did I ask him to head out together?

dialogues.jp: （かったりいぞ）
dialogues.en: (What a pain...)
dialogues.text: (What a pain...)

dialogues.jp:
隣で不適な笑みを浮かべ始める杉並を眺めなが
ら、『後悔先に立たず』を体験学習するのだっ
た……。
dialogues.en: I looked at him sneering with regret......
dialogues.text: I looked at him sneering with regret......

dialogues.jp: ◆杉並と帰る◆
dialogues.en: ◆Going with Suginami◆
dialogues.text: ◆Going with Suginami◆

dialogues.jp: 杉並と一緒に帰る事にした。
dialogues.en: I decided to go with Suginami.
dialogues.text: I decided to go with Suginami.
